text:
deploy-bot: completed rollout quant-v2 -> 100% (us + eu). starting post-deploy synthetic checks.

marta: EU synthetic prefill probe spiking at p95 with 502s starting 09:12 UTC. attaching quick probe outputs. :mag:

aj: which endpoint and model variant? paste the probe command output.

marta: probe hitting /v1/generate against quant-v2-eu, returns repeated 'upstream reset' in 6/10 samples.

lee: timing matches kv-prefill background jobs on eu1. p50 is fine, p95 and 5xx elevated.

sre-bot: alert created INC-293333: eu1 synthetic 5xx surge. paging oncall. :rotating_light:

aj: mitigation options: rollback globally, pin region to quant-v1, or reduce concurrency and re-run canary in eu. prefer region pin to minimize impact.

lee: agree, region pin and set reduced concurrency for eu quant-v2 hosts.

deploy-bot: applying traffic policy: route EU -> quant-v1, reduced-concurrency profile applied to quant-v2 eu hosts. auto-unpin disabled.

marta: probes back to baseline ~2m after pin. p95 normalized. :white_check_mark:

aj: posted short release note: "EU model traffic pinned to quant-v1 after quant-v2 rollout caused synthetic 5xx spike; investigating kv-prefill and warmup behavior."

lee: triage plan: collect heap/alloc metrics from eu1, run isolated quant-v2 canary with extended warmup and prefill, check kernel logs for OOM/NIC resets.

marta: uploaded logs and probe traces to incident INC-293333. initial signals point to memory churn during prefill.

aj: keeping auto-unpin off. if a quick config tweak helps we will hotpatch eu only; otherwise staged re-rollout with telemetry gating.

sre-bot: incident severity S2, oncall acknowledged.

lee: starting host-level checks now. will report back in the incident thread.

marta: thanks all. keeping this channel for coordination. :shipit:

(END)
